name: kifiya-ui
description: Kifiya UI kit monorepo: design tokens, React components, hooks and flows.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @kifiya/tokens build && pnpm --filter @kifiya/ui build && pnpm --filter @kifiya/hooks build && pnpm --filter @kifiya/flows build && pnpm --filter @kifiya/cli build && pnpm --filter @kifiya/mcp build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm verify
